spans.s:
√vṛdh 'grow'
present: [1.] várdhati várdhate etc. V.+ 
perfect: vavárdha vavṛdhe etc. V.+ vāvṛdhús etc. vāvṛdhé etc. vāvṛdhāti vāvṛdhīthā́s vāvṛdhásva etc. vāvṛdhéte vavṛdhánt vāvṛdhánt 
aorist: [2.] avṛdhat etc. vṛdhātas vṛdhātu vṛdhánt vṛdhāná -- [3.] avīvṛdhat etc. V.+ avīvṛdhata etc. -- [5.] avardhiṣṭa etc. E.+ vardhiṣīmáhi 
future: [1.] vartsyati vardhiṣyate -- [2.] vardhitā 
verbal: vṛddhá V.+ vardhitum vardhitvā vṛddhvā vṛdhé vṛdháse vāvṛdhádhyai 
secondary: intensive: varīvṛdh- -- desiderative: vivṛtsa- vivardhiṣa- -- causative: vardháyati vardháyate etc. V.+ vivardhayiṣa vardhāpayati 
derivatives: vṛ́dh V.+ vṛdhá V.+ várdha V.+ -vardhaka C. vardhin E.+ várdhana V.+ vardhanīya E.+ vṛdhás RV. vṛdhīká RV. vṛ́ddhi V.+ vardhitṛ́ RV. vardhman C. várddhra? AV.B. ūrdhvá V.+ vṛdhasāná RV. vardhiṣṇu C. vāvṛdhénya RV. vardhayitṛ C. vivardhayiṣu E.+ vardhāpana C. 
Compare √ṛdh. The asserted √2vṛdh 'cut' (used only of the navel-string) rests on a too narrow foundation to be admitted; it is probably a specialized application of this root.
